name: Infinity Crash adds 50% critical damage to Discordance and Chromatic Shard (#2941)
contract: Infinity Crash 706040's tooltip reads "Increases the critical damage of Discordance and Chromatic Shard by $s1%." In Spell.dbc it is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 15 (SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS), EffectBasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50%, EffectSpellClassMask [33554432,0,33554432]. Resolved against the full SpellFamilyName 28 set, word 0 bit 0x2000000 selects the nine Discordance ranks (503875-503880, 582758-582760) and word 2 bit 0x2000000 selects the nine Chromatic Shard ranks (501836-501840, 567543, 567544, 574346); Unmake's flags are [0,33554432,0], which the mask does not reach. Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus consumes SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS after crit_bonus -= damage and before crit_bonus += damage (Unit.cpp), so it scales the bonus portion, the standard "increases critical damage by X%" contract. Generic core machinery. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Discordance's crit damage modifier before the talent
Untalented, Discordance's crit bonus is unmodified
Untalented, Chromatic Shard's crit bonus is unmodified
Discordance's crit bonus rises by half
That is exactly +500 against the baseline
Chromatic Shard's crit bonus rises by half
The mask is not over-broad: Unmake keeps its own crit damage
